questions.stimulusText: [1] The science club wanted to compare two materials that might help keep lunches cool. [2] Members lined one identical container with felt and another with reflective foam. [3] They placed the same number of ice cubes in each container and recorded the temperature every fifteen minutes. [4] During the first trial, however, the felt-lined container sat closer to a sunny window. [5] Because the containers had not received equal amounts of sunlight, the results could not provide a fair comparison. [6] The club repeated the test with both containers on the same shaded table. [7] In the repeated trials, the reflective-foam container remained cooler for a longer period.
